kind: Tournament preparation hypotheses; candidates are not installed by this file

measurement.keeperMetricCaveat: Across46 saved reports with primary stats through live47, shotsOnTargetAgainst equals goalsAgainst in every report, totaling32each. Report counters alone cannot establish save percentage or keeper mechanism.
measurement.sampling: Verify kickoff setup and HOME/AWAY; preserve opponent and raw private evidence. Uncontrolled opponents confound comparisons. Keep unattributed games outside verified setup cohorts.

trials.hypothesis: Narrow goalkeeper movement and safer outlets reduce empty-goal exposure and immediate turnovers.
candidate: Only challenge a confirmed free ball in a small local goal area when it is safer than holding position
Retain built-in keeping when already positioned or ball state is ambiguous
Mirror goal geometry for HOME/AWAY
Use confirmed own possession before GK_DISTRIBUTE
Rank receivers by lane and nearby opponent pressure, rather than nearest teammate only
nativeChecks: wide ball outside box must not lure keeper out
opponent agentId_0 must not count as own possession
teammate possession must not emit GK_DISTRIBUTE
blocked nearest outlet versus open diagonal outlet
trials.rejection: Wrong team/ownership, keeper chases a distant ball, or repeated live increase in dangerous shots/turnovers

trials.hypothesis: One nearby presser and shorter pressure bursts retain defensive cover and late-match energy.
candidate: Choose one outfield presser from distance, stamina and role-cover cost
GK is never routine presser
Use short maintained pressure, then reassess
Prefer short support movement without sprint when tired
Keep a central defender behind the ball
nativeChecks: All five agents independently select the same presser on identical state
Tired forward does not chase across the pitch
Late deficit permits bounded extra risk without abandoning goalkeeper
traceChecks: Stamina distributions and sprint fractions over time, when actual fields exist
Observed pressure duration versus later possession recovery
Separate state snapshots from causal proof
trials.status: design; only local press/stamina checks exist in R1 pilot

trials.hypothesis: Passing into open lanes and supporting on distinct sides preserves possession while producing useful shots.
candidate: Check lane obstruction and receiver pressure before a pass
Allow a safe backward outlet under pressure
Do not recycle forever when a quality close shot exists
Keep one close support option and one player in depth
FWD1/FWD2 use different lanes
nativeChecks: Safe backward pass beats blocked forward pass
Unknown holder cannot pass or shoot
Mirror all progress calculations for AWAY
trials.status: design; R1 validates bounded passes/shots but has not established live improvement

trials.hypothesis: Reacting to persistent opponent shape is more useful than guessing a strategy from team name or command totals.
candidate: Treat opponent strategy as unknown until several actual state observations support it
Against a crowded ball side, seek a safe switch to the free side
Against a high defensive line, consider an open runner behind it
Against a compact deep block, keep width and offer a cutback
Use score/time and persistent evidence with minimum dwell time so tactics do not flip each tick
traceChecks: Observed opponent positions, lastAction, ball side and defensive line
Switches arise from model-visible evidence; no invented opponent history
trials.status: await verified live Runtime inputs before implementation
trials.deception: Create uncertainty through asymmetric support and varying the safe attack route, never through random illegal actions or abandoning shape

selection: Start with baseline, change one role or mechanism at a time, preserve rollback. Prefer repeatable legal behavior and observed match outcomes over speculative complexity. A final setup must include exact prompts/models/code hashes, role bindings template, Fitness evidence and restoration instructions.
